summary: Preserve browser cookie metadata and isolated live authentication validation, SSR product search, full bounded purchase-history paging, and exact-line cart mutations with read-after-write confirmation. Cart preview is default; explicit confirm enables mutations over CLI and MCP.
reason: The captured browser API uses cookie-derived identity headers, fulfillment-specific request shapes, and a complete observed add mutation; generic raw endpoint generation does not express this shopper workflow.
validated_outcome: Go tests and vet pass; real search, cart reads, online and in-store order details and authorized restored cart lifecycle are recorded separately in proofs.
